rungs.foldTest: 'APT28 (UAC-0028)' was involved in an event' -> 'APT28' was involved in an event: same claim, less detail

rejected.reason: Turla is a synonym/alias for UAC-0003. Moving from 'UAC-0003 (Turla)' to 'Turla' or 'UAC-0003' changes the naming convention but not the specificity of the entity.
UAC-0028 is a different reporting identifier for the same entity as APT28; it is not a coarser representation of the entity.
Sandworm is an unrelated entity (different referent) in the same category.

ladder.notes: The ladder addresses the common practice of including internal tracking IDs within a name. The UAC-0028 portion is a technical identifier; its removal leaves the primary known moniker, which constitutes a move to a coarser (less specific) description while preserving the identity.
